audit_status.source_base: Greek Titus text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for truth according to reverence, elders, overseer character, Cretan polemic with ethnic-stereotype safeguard.

verses.restored: Paul, servant of the Divine and apostle of Jesus Messiah, according to trust of chosen ones of the Divine and knowledge of truth according to reverence/godliness,

familiar.text: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

verses.restored: upon hope of age-long life, which the unlying Divine promised before age-long times,

familiar.text: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

verses.restored: but in its own seasons manifested his word in proclamation, with which I was entrusted according to command of our Savior/Healer Divine,

familiar.text: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

verses.restored: to Titus, genuine child according to common trust: grace and peace from Divine Father and Messiah Jesus our Savior/Healer.

familiar.text: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

verses.restored: For this reason I left you in Crete, so that you might set right the things lacking and appoint elders city by city, as I directed you:

familiar.text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

verses.restored: if anyone is above reproach, husband of one wife, having trusting children not accused of wastefulness or disorder.

familiar.text: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

verses.restored: For the overseer must be above reproach as steward of the Divine, not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for shameful gain,

familiar.text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

verses.restored: but hospitable, loving the beautiful/good, sound-minded, righteous/just, holy, self-controlled,

familiar.text: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

verses.restored: holding fast the trustworthy word according to the teaching, so that one may be able both to encourage in healthy teaching and to expose those contradicting.

familiar.text: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

verses.restored: For there are many disorderly ones, empty-talkers and deceivers, especially those from the circumcision,

familiar.text: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

verses.restored: whom it is necessary to silence, who overturn whole households, teaching what is not necessary for shameful gain.

familiar.text: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.

verses.restored: One of them, their own prophet, said: Cretans are always liars, harmful beasts, idle bellies.

familiar.text: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

verses.restored: This testimony is sharp; for this reason expose them sharply, so that they may be healthy in the trust,

familiar.text: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

verses.restored: not paying attention to Judean myths and commandments of humans turning away from the truth.

familiar.text: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

verses.restored: To the pure all things are pure, but to those defiled and untrusting nothing is pure, but both their mind and conscience are defiled.

familiar.text: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

verses.restored: They confess to know the Divine, but by works deny, being detestable and disobedient and unfit for every beautiful/good work.

familiar.text: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

safety_note: Titus 1 uses sharp ethnic and intra-Jewish polemic. Do not universalize the Cretan quotation as an ethnic stereotype, and do not turn 'circumcision' language into anti-Jewish contempt. The local problem is harmful teaching for gain that overturns households.
translation_notes: Leadership is steward-care and character, not domination.
Healthy teaching is tied to beautiful/good work and truth according to reverence.
